title: Anthropic details early drug development work with six partners and says it has acquired Mithril, a one-person company working on muscular dystrophy (Anthropic)
summary: Anthropic: Anthropic details early drug development work with six partners and says it has acquired Mithril, a one-person company working on muscular dystrophy — There are many opportunities to speed up drug development, even beyond the most commonly discussed applications of AI, like proposing initial designs for new molecules.
